Method of Attack: Deployed ScreenConnect remote management software to gain foothold on network, execute commands to exfiltrate data, steal backup information, download malware including Vidar Trojan, bankers, PS2EXE, and Cobalt Strike beacons, disable Windows Defender, and finally install Zeppelin Ransomware
Used PowerShell commands and CMD scripts to prepare system, disable security features, and execute ransomware payload
Impacted Systems: compromised workstations using ConnectWise Control (ScreenConnect) software
Attack Vector: Deployment of ScreenConnect remote management software by attackers themselves on compromised workstations
Indicators of Compromise: PowerShell commands downloading and executing oxfordnew.exe or oxford.exe in C:\Windows\Temp folder
Registry file installation configuring public encryption key
